title: 印度之歌
source: 印度之歌---隨風遠去的心情.docx

zh: 比泰姬瑪哈的倒影更安靜，更安靜的
比壯麗淒美的城堡更安靜，更安靜的
比微妙隨性的浮雕更安靜，更安靜的
比蒼桑迷幻的寺廟更安靜，更安靜的
比縈繞宿命的焚香更安靜，更安靜的
比漂泊沾塵的袈裟更安靜，更安靜的
比自覺自化的落葉更安靜，更安靜的
比入禪悟道的手指更安靜，更安靜的
比寂光烟塵的暮色更安靜，更安靜的
比澄空映月的夜晚更安靜，更安靜的
en: Quieter and quieter than Taj Mahal's reflection
is the castle of Agra Fort.
Quieter and quieter than a magnificent castle
Quieter and quieter than subtle casual reliefs
Quieter and quieter than the mulberry psychedelic temples
Quieter and quieter than the incense of fate
Quieter and quieter than wandering dusty swaddles
It's a fallen leaf of Bodhi.
Quieter and quieter than the fallen leaves of self-consciousness
Quieter and quieter than the fingers that enter the path of Zen enlightenment
is the twilight of the Ganges.
Quieter and quieter than the sooty twilight
Quieter and quieter than a moonlit night
It's the feeling of going away with the wind.

zh: 在晨霧洣濛的村莊小路
en: Deep in the narrow door of Quxiang Alley
That room is a heavy Indian carpet.
As soon as it spreads out, it's colorful and rich.
Mirrored in this life and the next
Village Trail in the Morning Mist
Following in the footsteps of ancient civilizations
Mood to go with the wind

zh: 彷彿沒入大武山的暮色
積雪的喜馬拉雅山腳下
en: as if immersed in the twilight of Mt. Dawu
The rhythm of the iron bridge
I hope you have a dream.
That's what the music teacher said.
At the foot of the snowy Himalayas
The Ganges River is slowly flowing through

points.zh: Taj Mahal (泰姬瑪哈陵)，這座鑲嵌了28種寶石的白色大理石陵墓，是蒙兀兒王朝(成吉斯汗後代自中亞進入印度北部，建立了蒙兀兒王朝Mughal Empire，1526-1758) 第五代皇帝沙賈汗 (Shah Jahan) 為紀念他龐愛的皇后而建立的。於1631年動工興建，動用了兩萬名來自印度和中亞的工匠，歷時22年。陵墓的規劃和設計，是融合了波斯，中亞伊斯蘭教的建築和傳統印度敎建築而成，不僅有宏大壯麗之美，幾何造型之趣，而且散放著和諧，寧靜和莊嚴的詩意氛圍。大理石建築會隨著雲天光線的不同，微妙的變化色澤。
points.en: Taj Mahal (Taj Mahal), a white marble mausoleum set with 28 stones, was built by Shah Jahan, the fifth emperor of the Mughal dynasty (Genghis Khan's descendants entered northern India from Central Asia and established the Mughal Empire, 1526-1758) in memory of his beloved queen. Construction began in 1631 and involved 20,000 artisans from India and Central Asia over a period of 22 years. The planning and design of the mausoleum is a combination of Persian, Central Asian Islamic architecture and traditional Hindu architecture, which not only has magnificent beauty and geometric shape, but also exudes harmony, serenity and a solemn poetic atmosphere. Marble buildings change color subtly with the light of the clouds.

points.zh: 16世紀有三個穆斯林帝國擁有遼濶的地盤，其中之—就是位於印度的蒙兀兒王朝， 其首都就是安格拉 (Agra)。現今的安格拉是—個地道的印度北方城市，但它擁有泰姬瑪哈陵Taj Mahal，阿格拉堡Agra Fort和法特普希克利Fatehpur Sikri三個世界遺產，是印度最受青睞的觀光城市。阿格拉堡是印度--伊斯蘭藝術頂峰時期的代表作，旣是堅固的城堡，也是雄偉的宮殿。是蒙兀兒帝國阿克巴Akbar大帝以8年時間建造的壯麗建築， 直到他的孫子沙賈汗Shah Jahan 在位時還不斷擴建。不過，在極盛的時候，沙賈汗卻被自己的兒子軟禁在城堡内，當年由他祖父打造的20米紅沙岩瑰高牆，成了難以越過的獄牆，只能孤坐城中小樓，遙望他—手興建的白色泰姬瑪哈，思念愛妻。
points.en: In the 16th century, there were three Muslim empires with Liaoning territory, one of which was the Mughal dynasty in India, and its capital was Angra. Today, Angola is an authentic northern Indian city, but with three World Heritage Sites: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri, it is India's most popular tourist city. Agra Fort is a masterpiece of Hindu-Islamic art at its peak, a fortified castle and a majestic palace. It is a magnificent structure built by Akbar the Great of the Mughal Empire over a period of 8 years, and continued to expand until the reign of his grandson Shah Jahan. However, at the height of his prosperity, Shah Jahan was confined to the castle by his own son. The 20-meter red sandstone rock wall built by his grandfather at that time became a prison wall that was difficult to overcome. He could only sit in the small building in the city and look at him — the white Taj Mahal built by his hand, and miss his wife.

points.zh: Orchha (歐恰古城) 始建於16世紀，曾經是拉傑普特人Rajput所建立的班德拉王國的首都，如今是一個僻遠小村落。幾百年下來，—個極盛的都城衰敗成小村莊，無足訝異，令人驚奇的是， 雖然經歷無數的戰亂人禍，當年的城牆，宮殿和寺廟都完整保存下來。雖然有這樣壯麗而精美的古代建築群，但遊客寥少無幾，—片靜謐。走進城堡，穿梭在宮殿和廟宇之中，隨處可見充滿滄桑感的壁畫和雕刻。登城遠眺，散落在林䕃中的古代建築若隱若現，連座落於山水中的小鎮也浸染了古樸和蒼涼。
points.en: Founded in the 16th century, Orchha was once the capital of the Kingdom of Bandera, founded by the Rajputs, and is now a remote and small village. Hundreds of years later, — a prosperous capital city decayed into a small village, not surprisingly, despite the countless wars and man-made disasters, the walls, palaces and temples of that year were fully preserved. Although there are such magnificent and exquisite ancient buildings, there are few tourists — quiet. Walk into the castle and walk through palaces and temples, filled with mulberry murals and sculptures. Overlooking the city from afar, the ancient buildings scattered in the woods are looming, and even the small towns nestled in the mountains and rivers are drenched in antiquity and coolness.

points.zh: Khajuraho小鎮在10到13世紀是昌德拉王朝的首都，其極盛時期是在公元1000年前後，現今所見的《卡鳩拉荷性廟群》大都建於這個時期。歷史上，各種宗敎都把性愛列爲禁忌，現今的印度在男歡女愛方面也還相當保守。然而，這個千年前建造的印度寺廟群， 幾乎每座寺廟牆壁都雕滿了男女性愛的畫面，其大膽露骨的程度讓現代人也膛目結舌。壁雕所藴含的宗敎信仰，人性理念，生活規範，雕塑技巧和藝術觀點，都讓人心動而欲窺究竟。
points.en: The town of Khajuraho was the capital of the Chandra dynasty from the 10th to the 13th centuries, and its peak was around 1000 AD, when most of the Cagiuraho temples seen today were built. Historically, various clansmen have listed sex as taboo, and today's India is also quite conservative in terms of male and female love. However, this group of Indian temples built a thousand years ago, almost every temple wall is carved with pictures of sex between men and women, and its boldness is bold enough to make modern people tongue-tied. The beliefs of the clan, the concept of human nature, the norms of life, the sculpture skills and the artistic viewpoint contained in the wall sculpture are all impressive and revealing.

points.zh: Varanasi (瓦拉納西) 位於恆河岸邊的中等城市，卻保留著1500多座寺廟，每年有400多個宗敎節日。公元前五世紀佛祖釋迦牟尼在這裡傳敎，公元七世紀中國唐代高僧玄奘到此朝拜取經。十―世紀穆斯林佔領此地直到十八世紀，其間建立了許多清真寺。不過瓦拉納西還是因印度教而聲名遠播。飲恆河水，敬濕婆神，結交聖人，住瓦拉納西，是印度敎徒一生最大的願望。百分之八十以上的印度人是印度敎徒，瓦拉納西是濕婆神的領地，是印度敎徒的聖地。
points.en: Located in a medium-sized city on the banks of the Ganges River, Varanasi has more than 1,500 temples and more than 400 festivals every year. The Buddha Shakyamuni preached here in the 5th century BC, and the high priest Xuanzheng of the Tang Dynasty in China came here in the 7th century AD to worship and learn the Sutras. Tenth-century Muslims occupied the area until the eighteenth century, during which many mosques were built. Still, Varanasi was famous for its Hinduism. Drinking Ganges water, paying homage to Shiva, making friends with saints, and living in Varanasi are the greatest wishes of the Hindus in their lifetime. More than 80% of Indians are Hindustani, and Varanasi is the territory of Shiva, the holy place of Hindustani.

points.zh: 恆河 (Gange River) 發源於喜馬拉雅山的冰川，長2500公里，流經印度的東北部，向南注入孟加拉灣。人類四大古文明都是大河文明，但是沒有那個大河流域像恆河流域這樣，還保留著原有的神話傳說，宗敎儀式，古老俗習和生活作息。尤其是瓦拉納西近旁的恆河，每年有數百萬印度敎徒自四面八方，雲集在這裡沐浴，淨身，敬拜，冥想。生前至少要在恆河沐浴—次，讓聖河洗淨罪孽，死後則希望在恆河邊火葬，撒骨灰於恆河中。
points.en: The Gange River originates from the glaciers of the Himalayas and flows 2,500 kilometers through the northeast of India and into the Bay of Bengal to the south. The four ancient civilizations of mankind are all river civilizations, but there is no river basin like the Ganges River Basin, which still retains the original myths and legends, rituals, ancient customs and lifestyles. Especially the Ganges near Varanasi, where millions of Indians flock to bathe, purify, worship, and meditate every year. At least bathe in the Ganges — times, let the Holy River wash away sins, and after death, hope to be cremated by the Ganges and scatter ashes in the Ganges.

points.zh:
“菩提”一詞為古印度語 (卽梵語) Bodhi的音譯，意思是覺悟，智慧，用以指人如夢初醒，豁然開朗，頓悟真理，達到超凡脫俗的境界。 相傳2500年前，佛祖釋迦牟尼在—棵大樹下修成正果成道，此樹便因而稱為菩提樹。在印度，不論是佛教，印度教還是耆那教，都視菩提樹為“ 神聖之樹 ”，印度教徒相信菩提樹凝聚各種美德，可以使人實現願望和解脫罪惡。時至今日，印度敎的沙陀們還經常在菩提樹下唸經默禱，而每個佛教寺廟都至少種植—棵菩提樹，印度政府更對菩提樹給以國寶級的維修保䕶。
唐朝初年，禪宗僧人神秀和師兄慧能的牆壁對話，寫下的禪偈 :“ 身是菩提樹，心是明鏡臺，時時勤拂拭，莫使惹塵埃。”慧能看後回寫了—偈“ 菩提本無樹，明鏡亦非臺，本來無一物，何處惹塵埃。”這對師兄弟以物表意，借物論道的對招，千古流傳，議論紛紛，也使菩提樹因而沾染著禪味禪思。
菩提樹是一種桑科榕屬植物，原產於印度，中國西南和中南半島。樹幹粗壯雄偉，樹冠亭亭如蓋，十分優雅。有懸垂氣根如鬚，樹葉濃綠，網狀葉脈，成心形或水滴形，有—條明顯延伸的頂端尾尖，是熱帶植物排水的特徵，植物學上稱之為“ 滴水葉尖“，是特色也十分漂亮。菩提葉茶含有類黃酮，有安神鎮靜，催眠效果。臺南公園有一棵全臺灣最大最老的百年菩提樹。
德國柏林的菩提樹大街，德語是 Unter den Linden，奧地利作曲家舒伯特的名曲《菩提樹》，德語是 Der Lindenbaum，實際上德語的 Linden 和 Lindenbaum是椴樹而非菩提樹。椴樹葉子亦呈心形，導至早期學者的誤譯，延續至今。
points.en: The word "Bodhi" is a transliteration of the ancient Hindi (Sanskrit) Bodhi, which means enlightenment, wisdom, to refer to people waking up like a dream, suddenly enlightened, and enlightened to the truth, to achieve a transcendent and secular state. Legend has it that 2,500 years ago, Buddha Shakyamuni cultivated the enlightenment of the righteous fruit under a big tree, which became known as the Bodhi Tree. In India, both Buddhism, Hinduism and Jainism regard the linden tree as a "sacred tree". Hindus believe that the linden tree condenses all kinds of virtues and can make people realize their wishes and free themselves from sin. To this day, the Sadras of India often pray in silence under the linden tree, and every Buddhist temple has at least planted a linden tree, and the Indian government has given the linden tree a national treasure-level maintenance guarantee. In the early Tang Dynasty, Shenxiu, a Zen monk, and his senior brother Wisei had a conversation on the wall and wrote Zen: "The body is a bodhi tree, and the heart is a mirror platform. The time and time are wiped, so as not to cause dust. "Hui Neng wrote back after looking at it —" Bodhi, there is no tree, the mirror is not a platform, there is nothing, where to cause dust. "This pair of apprentice-brothers expressed themselves in material terms, borrowing the opposing moves of materialism, which were passed down through the ages, and the discussions were mixed, which also made the linden tree contaminated with Zen meditation. Linden is a plant of the genus Banyan, native to India, southwest China and the south-central peninsula. The tree trunk is stout and majestic, and the canopy pavilion is elegant like a lid. There are dangling roots and beards, dark green leaves, mesh veins, heart-shaped or water droplet-shaped, and there is — a clearly extended top tail tip, which is a feature of tropical plant drainage, which is called "dripping leaf tip" in botany, and is also very beautiful. Linden leaf tea contains flavonoids, which have a calming and hypnotic effect. Tainan Park has one of the largest and oldest centennial linden trees in Taiwan. Linden Street in Berlin, Germany, German is Unter den Linden, Austrian composer Schubert's famous song "Linden Tree", German is Der Lindenbaum, in fact, German Linden and Lindenbaum are linden trees rather than linden trees. The leaves of the linden tree were also heart-shaped, leading to a misinterpretation by early scholars, which continues to this day.

points.zh: 《印度之歌》(Song of India) 是俄羅斯作曲家 Rimsky Korsakov (1844~1908) 所作的歌劇 Sadko中的―段唱曲。英文歌詞中有《And still the snowy Himalayas rise / In ancient majesty before our eyes / Beyond the plains, above the pines / While through the ever,  never changing land / As silently as any native band / That moves at night,  the Ganges shines / Then I hear the song that only India can sing》。中文歌詞由晨曦填寫，歌詞中有《俯瞰印度恒河水 / 數她的文化傳說智慧 / 雲啊 / 張開帆 / 帶我仙境—探 / 為何那神秘 / 總是聲聲呼喚》。
points.en: Song of India is a song in the opera Sadko by the Russian composer Rimsky Korsakov (1844-1908). And still the snowy Himalayas rise/In ancient majesty before our eyes/Beyond the plains, above the pines/While through the ever, never changing land/As silently as any native band/That moves at night, the Ganges shines/Then I hear the song that only India can sing. The Chinese lyrics are filled by Chen Xi, and the lyrics include "Overlooking the Ganges Water in India/Counting Her Cultural Legend Wisdom/Cloud Ah/Opening the Sail/Take Me to Wonderland — Exploring/Why That Mystery/Always Calling".

points.zh: 泰戈爾 (Rabindranath Tagore，1861-1941)，印度文學家，詩人，哲學家和印度民族主義者。1913年， 以《吉檀迦利》成為第―位獲得諾貝爾文學獎的亞洲人。他的詩含有深刻的宗敎和哲學意味， 讚美人生和自然的真純和諧。印度國歌《人民的意志》是出自他的詩歌作品。他的作品《 漂鳥集 》的第一首是 : 「夏日的漂鳥，來到我窗前，發出啁啾歌聲，然後翩然飛去。秋日的黃葉，沒有歌唱，只一聲嘆息，便飄然落下。」
points.en: Rabindranath Tagore (1861-1941), Indian writer, poet, philosopher and Hindu nationalist, became the first Asian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 with Gittangali. His poems contain profound religious and philosophical meanings, praising the true harmony of life and nature. The Indian national anthem "The Will of the People" is from his poetry. The first song in his work "Floating Birds" is: "The birds of summer came to my window, chirped, and flew away. The yellow leaves of autumn, without singing, just sighed and drifted down.”
